governance.systemOfRecord: This register and the work-package documents are the execution system of record; the source audit remains the finding system of record.
governance.closureRule: No item closes on implementation alone. Automated verification, named human validation, evidence publication, rollout decision, and rollback readiness are mandatory.
governance.changeRule: Any scope, dependency, acceptance, or risk change requires an ADR or decision-log update and traceability review.

workPackages.title: Deterministic personas, organizations, packages, and fixtures
Read completeness, provenance, and error taxonomy
Action, export, and artifact truth contract
Capability parity and staged entitlement enforcement
Immediate route aliases and false-control removal

traceItems.title: Headline inventory metrics do not have a trustworthy aggregation boundary
traceItems.currentEvidence: Page-sliced KPIs, swallowed read failures, hard-coded low-stock threshold and USD remain confirmed; an existing inventory read service is a partial foundation.
traceItems.boundary: inventory read model and inventory list page
traceItems.outcome: Service-owned, scoped, provenance-bearing KPIs invariant to pagination.
traceItems.rollback: Revert UI to prior read path only behind visible degraded-state banner; never substitute zero for unavailable.
traceItems.residualRisk: Legacy downstream consumers may still infer completeness.

traceItems.title: Currency and locale are not a system-wide display contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: 59 heuristic lines across 26 current files require classification; lib/i18n/formatters.ts still defaults to USD while some domain display-context foundations exist.
traceItems.boundary: server read models, shared formatters, UI copy, notifications and exports
traceItems.outcome: One server-derived DisplayContext and zero unapproved production money literals.
traceItems.rollback: Per-surface formatter flag with telemetry; no silent fallback to USD.
traceItems.residualRisk: Historical stored currency semantics may be ambiguous.

traceItems.title: Module/package access is not yet a closed UI enforcement contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Current inventory: 19 modules, 387 surfaces, 353 mapped, 257 enforcement candidates, 6 unmapped and 4 missing permissions; default mode is observe with explicit enforce islands.
traceItems.boundary: routes, actions, sidebar, search, shortcuts, command surfaces and provider state
traceItems.outcome: One auditable capability decision shared by UI visibility and server authorization.
traceItems.rollback: Return affected capability policy to observe mode; preserve server authorization and audit logs.

traceItems.title: Visible actions can be dead or simulated
traceItems.currentEvidence: Inventory/settings users expose handlerless Export controls; CustomerQuickActions simulates export completion; real PO/reconciliation exports provide reference paths.
traceItems.boundary: enabled controls, async business actions, downloads and success messaging
traceItems.outcome: Every enabled action produces a verifiable outcome; exports return evidence-bearing artifacts.
traceItems.rollback: Disable action with explicit reason; do not restore simulated completion.
traceItems.residualRisk: Non-button interaction affordances may evade inventory.

traceItems.title: Current public/auth routes have serious WCAG failures
traceItems.currentEvidence: Earlier axe evidence is stale after ARIA changes; active auth fields still lack aria-invalid/describedby/live-region/autocomplete semantics. Fresh public smoke passes routing, not WCAG.
traceItems.outcome: WCAG 2.2 AA public/auth experience with usable keyboard and screen-reader flows.
traceItems.rollback: Restore prior layout only if it retains remediated semantic field primitives.
traceItems.residualRisk: Automated tools cannot prove full assistive-technology usability.

traceItems.title: Information architecture contains duplicate and misleading routes
traceItems.currentEvidence: Two create-item aliases now redirect, but item lists, suppliers, locations, tax rates and auth versions still require canonical disposition.
traceItems.boundary: localized public and protected route tree
traceItems.outcome: One canonical route per intent with typed metadata and governed aliases.
traceItems.rollback: Re-enable time-boxed alias redirect, never a divergent implementation.

traceItems.title: Theme preference and actual screen behavior disagree
traceItems.currentEvidence: 91 forced-dark lines, 72 manual-color TSX files, and globals.css at 1,924 lines with 288 hex and 297 rgb/rgba literals.
traceItems.boundary: tokens, appearance setting, shared primitives and module surfaces
traceItems.outcome: Certified light/dark/system behavior through semantic tokens, subject to ADR-UI-004.
traceItems.rollback: Per-module semantic-token compatibility layer; prevent new theme islands.

traceItems.title: Dashboard shortcuts are not fully role/capability derived
traceItems.currentEvidence: Operating-truth and enhanced-dashboard shortcut lists remain static for owner, POS, inventory, finance, payroll, compliance, sales and purchases.
traceItems.boundary: role home, quick actions and operating truth
traceItems.outcome: Server-owned, capability-filtered, urgency-ranked cockpit.
traceItems.rollback: Restore prior layout only with capability filtering retained.
traceItems.residualRisk: Ranking may hide low-frequency but important work.

traceItems.title: Registration front-loads marketing and configuration before task progress
traceItems.currentEvidence: Active registration remains multi-step and requests organization/location/display configuration before workspace value.
traceItems.boundary: account creation through first operational task
traceItems.outcome: Minimal signup plus resumable, role-aware onboarding.
traceItems.rollback: Return to prior steps without losing persisted progress or accessibility primitives.

traceItems.title: Login is visually polished but cognitively over-composed
traceItems.currentEvidence: Desktop login retains a dense assurance/modules side panel and small ornamental status hierarchy.
traceItems.outcome: Form-dominant, concise, trustworthy login experience.
traceItems.rollback: Content/layout flag retaining repaired semantics.
traceItems.residualRisk: Brand stakeholders may resist content reduction.

traceItems.title: Route-state behavior is not yet a complete registered contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: 11 loading, 23 error, 14 layout and 2 not-found files; only 38 pages match explicit route-state heuristics, with uneven denial handling.
traceItems.outcome: Declared loading/empty/filtered_empty/partial/stale/error/denied/locked/not_configured/success states.
traceItems.rollback: Shared primitive compatibility mapping; never collapse partial/error into empty.
traceItems.residualRisk: Rare state combinations require production telemetry.

traceItems.title: Large client components concentrate regression and performance risk
traceItems.currentEvidence: Current hotspots range from 1,059 to 2,357 lines; graph evidence is stale and must be refreshed before decomposition.
traceItems.outcome: Characterization-backed separation of read model, orchestration, state renderer, table/form/dialog and actions.
traceItems.rollback: Small reversible extractions and per-surface flags; no big-bang rewrite.
traceItems.residualRisk: Hidden coupling may surface after graph refresh.

traceItems.title: Authenticated visual certification is narrower than the product surface
traceItems.currentEvidence: 10 current E2E spec files and 6 current axe-integrated files for 139 localized pages; authenticated three-browser and screen-reader evidence is absent.
traceItems.outcome: Reusable role storage states, deterministic fixtures and blocking risk-weighted certification.
traceItems.rollback: Block release or roll back affected cohort; do not waive missing Tier-0/Tier-1 evidence.
traceItems.residualRisk: Matrix cost and flake without fixture discipline.

traceItems.title: Dense tables are not governed by one responsive contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Many domain tables retain 860-1680px minimum widths with inconsistent mobile/card behavior.
traceItems.outcome: One accessible responsive table contract with safe actions and export parity.
traceItems.rollback: Per-table adapter preserving filters and data.
traceItems.residualRisk: True dense grids may require scoped horizontal scrolling.

traceItems.title: Native prompts/confirms create inconsistent high-risk interactions
traceItems.currentEvidence: Accountant access uses window.prompt; item flows use window.confirm.
traceItems.outcome: Accessible controlled dialogs with reason, consequences, focus, audit correlation and retry safety.
traceItems.rollback: Fallback controlled dialog, never native prompt for audited actions.
traceItems.residualRisk: Third-party integrations may emit native dialogs.

traceItems.title: Raw image usage remains in interactive product surfaces
traceItems.currentEvidence: Five raw img nodes remain across POS/item/carousel surfaces.
traceItems.outcome: Optimized, dimensioned, semantically correct images with offline fallback.
traceItems.rollback: Known-dimension fallback component with cached asset behavior.
traceItems.residualRisk: Remote image domains and offline cache policy.

traceItems.title: Literal UI copy is broadly distributed
traceItems.currentEvidence: 53 files directly reference next-intl; broad literal-copy heuristic remains and needs classification.
traceItems.boundary: user-visible copy, states, notifications and exports
traceItems.outcome: Typed message IDs or governed co-located maps with EN/FR and pseudo-localization coverage.
traceItems.rollback: Message fallback with missing-key telemetry; never silently omit content.

traceItems.title: Global CSS and alternate theme islands are too large to govern safely
traceItems.currentEvidence: globals.css remains 1,924 lines with large literal-color surface and multiple forced-theme islands.
traceItems.boundary: global styles, semantic tokens and component recipes
traceItems.outcome: Frozen token API, shared recipes and ratcheted exceptions.
traceItems.rollback: Compatibility aliases with expiry; no restoration of unowned theme islands.
traceItems.residualRisk: Legacy selectors can have non-local effects.

traceItems.title: Some legacy forms have fixed-width assumptions
traceItems.currentEvidence: Legacy verify/reset/invited forms retain w-[400px] patterns.
traceItems.outcome: Full-width constrained forms that reflow at 320px and 400% zoom.
traceItems.rollback: Responsive compatibility wrapper retaining field semantics.

traceItems.title: Inventory summary read-model contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Existing getInventoryStats is partial foundation.
traceItems.outcome: Scoped, as-of, provenance-bearing metrics.
traceItems.rollback: Read-path flag with degraded-state display.

traceItems.title: Read completeness and failure contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Null-to-empty behavior exists in inventory and may exist elsewhere.
traceItems.outcome: Complete/partial/stale/unavailable semantics.
traceItems.rollback: Compatibility adapter that preserves error semantics.

traceItems.title: DisplayContext contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Partial module-specific foundations; global formatter still defaults USD.
traceItems.outcome: Locale, currency, time zone, number format and organization/location scope.
traceItems.rollback: Explicit context compatibility layer; no silent currency default.

traceItems.title: Capability decision contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: RBAC stronger than module entitlement; observe/enforce modes coexist.
traceItems.boundary: permission, module, organization and location decisions
traceItems.outcome: Available/locked/hidden/temporarily_unavailable/not_configured with reason/evidence.
traceItems.rollback: Policy-level observe mode.

traceItems.title: Canonical route registry contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Duplicate routes and inconsistent metadata remain.
traceItems.outcome: Typed owner/module/capability/breadcrumb/canonical/alias/retirement metadata.
traceItems.rollback: Time-boxed locale-preserving aliases.

traceItems.title: Action and evidence-bearing artifact contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Dead/simulated exports coexist with working implementations.
traceItems.outcome: Executable/disabled/locked states and artifact metadata.
traceItems.rollback: Explicit disablement.

traceItems.title: Accessible field, state, and dialog primitives
traceItems.currentEvidence: Auth semantics and native dialogs are incomplete.
traceItems.outcome: WCAG-aligned semantics, focus, announcement and recovery.
traceItems.rollback: Semantic compatibility wrapper.

traceItems.title: Semantic visual token and component recipe contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Forced theme/manual color/global CSS debt is confirmed.
traceItems.outcome: Governed light/dark/system and documented exceptions.
traceItems.rollback: Versioned token aliases.

traceItems.title: Resumable onboarding contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Registration and operational setup are coupled.
traceItems.outcome: Persisted, role-aware, skippable/recoverable onboarding steps.
traceItems.rollback: Preserve progress across version fallback.

traceItems.title: Route-role-capability certification evidence contract
traceItems.currentEvidence: Current automation is narrow and graph evidence stale.
traceItems.boundary: manifest, fixtures, automated and human evidence
traceItems.outcome: Risk-tiered, freshness-bound, reproducible certification.
traceItems.rollback: Block or reverse cohort release.
